courses.title: AI Infrastructure Design for Engineering Teams
courses.description: AI Infrastructure Design for Engineering Teams takes you from the basics of machine learning infrastructure design to applying it on a realistic DevOps Engineer (AI Specialization) scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to model operations pipelines, enough to use it alongside machine learning infrastructure design day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying machine learning infrastructure design to a real DevOps Engineer (AI Specialization) scenario
Practicing machine learning infrastructure design through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to model operations pipelines
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
